selection_policy.asr_prompt: A few relevant candidates selected per clip; never the whole catalog. Log exact prompt and output.
selection_policy.neighbor_context: Inspect both before and after during reconciliation; the current automated context pass only supplies preceding text.
selection_policy.protect_baseline: Recheck every changed word, including words outside the uncertain span. Prompted confidence or name recognition alone is not proof.
selection_policy.publication: Keep transcript_original frozen; retain verified current text unless the owner specifically approves a correction. Uncertain cases remain uncertain.
selection_policy.prompt_choice_limit: No fixed production limit chosen until a pilot compares results. Shortlist size and prompt length must be recorded.

phonetic_policy.candidate_ranking: Sound similarity generates suggestions, not probabilities or automatic substitutions.
phonetic_policy.pronunciations: Generated en-us IPA is not a confirmed local pronunciation. Proper names may need manual variants with sources.
phonetic_policy.locations: One business name can refer to several branches. Resolve the branch separately.
phonetic_policy.observed_asr_forms: Recognition errors are retained as evidence notes, never treated as legitimate spoken aliases.
phonetic_policy.person_names: Keep shared first names and similar surnames as separate candidates. Nicknames retain evidence status and date limits; phonetic matches do not establish speaker identity. Preserve the spoken nickname in accepted transcripts.

coverage_notes.scope: American Fork apartment/townhome community names, city inventory parks, public landmarks, and selected nearby regional landmarks. Not an exhaustive apartment directory; individual building numbers are not mapped.
coverage_notes.park_inventory: All 35 facility names in the March 31, 2026 packet existing-open-space table are represented, including trails and special-use sites; Quail Cove is also retained separately. Historical inventory-only additions carry historical status.
coverage_notes.forms: Canonical and documented alternate names are sourced; proposed shortened lookup forms are labeled in notes. No new local nickname is claimed solely from a name abbreviation.
